experiment: P3o-B low-power delay-peak and local time-frequency dual-view representation
research_question: After P3o-A showed that coverage, joint checkpoint selection, and CP-safe calibration cannot recover low-power recall, can a physically shaped delay-peak plus local STFT/instantaneous-frequency representation improve safety-constrained ISRJ detection without degrading joint parameter sensing?
hypothesis: The dual view with exclusive MFT-only versus ISRJ-only prototype contrast provides information absent from the raw time convolution and either view alone. It must improve the full dual-view no-contrast control on fresh identities; co-occurring MFT and ISRJ examples are never treated as mutually exclusive.

models.T_time: equal-width raw I/Q temporal convolution baseline
models.D_delay: multi-scale normalized complex-autocorrelation delay sequence only
models.F_time_frequency: local complex STFT magnitude plus frame-to-frame instantaneous-frequency proxy only
models.DF_no_contrast: delay and time-frequency encoders fused; BCE plus masked parameter regression only
models.DF_exclusive_contrast: same dual view plus prototype cross-entropy only for MFT=1,ISRJ=0 and MFT=0,ISRJ=1 samples

fixed_representation.delay: complex autocorrelation magnitude lags 1..1024, plus 7- and 31-sample smoothed sequences
fixed_representation.time_frequency: STFT n_fft=128, hop_length=64, Hann window; channels log magnitude and adjacent-frame phase increment divided by pi

training.parameter_loss: 0.1 * masked SmoothL1 over label=1 AND parameter_mask=1 AND finite(target)
training.contrast_loss: 0.05 * prototype cross entropy on exclusive MFT-only/ISRJ-only samples; zero if an exclusive group is absent from a batch

selection_and_safety.checkpoint: C_joint: maximum early macro-AUPR among epochs with early oracle parameter macro-NMAE <= 1.01 times the early minimum
selection_and_safety.threshold: per-class F1 on calibration; replace only ISRJ threshold with the lowest score satisfying a 95% one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper FPR <=0.10 in every regime x power calibration cell

failure_rule: If the frozen candidate fails, do not tune contrast weight, width, STFT settings, ACF lags, threshold, checkpoint, or seed920000000. Report whether the failure is representation insufficiency, safety-calibration conflict, or contrast-specific harm; only a new hypothesis on fresh identities may follow.
